requirements.criterion: Only supported trusted admission gateways can issue; upstream authentication and replay remain mandatory.
Proposal rejects any changed TrainOS context identity, revision, digest or observation timestamp.
Future/stale context, expired proposals and backwards clocks fail closed.
No proposal can authorize actuation; HMAC tamper or signed forbidden flags are rejected.
Latest journaled gateway participates and PREPARED state blocks issuance.
Root-only fixtures skip before privileged setup under UID1000, and skipped counts remain explicit.
An observed expiry cannot be undone by wall-clock rollback within one bridge, including after invalid/stale attempts; concurrent reviews share the fence.

limitations: 68 root/cross-UID tests were explicitly skipped; these are not passed checks.
Opt-in local review API; live TrainOS and production IPC are not wired to the bridge.
No external model, physical control, independent operator authentication or certification.
Clock, current context and output HMAC key must be provided by trusted components.
Input admission and proposal issuance are not an atomic distributed operation.
Existing SQLite/checkpoint atomicity, privileged rollback and mandatory legacy fencing gaps remain.
Clock high-watermark is process-local to one bridge and is reset by a new instance or process restart; there is no persisted/cross-process monotonic clock.
